import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static long process(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long base_value = 0, count_digits = 0;
        while (base_value * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            base_value = base_value * 10 + 1;
            ++count_digits;
        }
        long option_one = count_digits * (n / base_value) + process(n % base_value);
        long option_two = count_digits + 1;
        n = 10 * base_value + 1 - n;
        option_two += count_digits * (n / base_value) + process(n % base_value);
        return Math.min(option_one, option_two);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long val = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(process(val));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
